notes: Posted 17 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'STARTING (8)': Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe, Death Star, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Alderaan, Prepared Defenses ('Prepaired Defenses'), A Million Voices Crying Out, 'IMO' and Imperial Decree; these count toward the 60.
The title's '62 cards' is the poster's count including two Commence Primary Ignition retrieved with A Million Voices Crying Out; the list itself totals 60 as published.
Posted 'IMO' (a starting card) matches no card name or known nickname; kept as written (UNKNOWN) and counted. Best guess: Imperial Arrest Order (usually 'IAO'), a common starting Effect in this era.

Posted 'A.Thrawn', 'A.Piett', 'A.Ozzel', 'A.Motti', 'A.Chiraneau' dested Grand Admiral Thrawn, Admiral Piett, Admiral Ozzel, Admiral Motti and Admiral Chiraneau (the strategy fetches them as Admirals with Imperial Command); 'Capt.Godherdt' Captain Godherdt; 'Com.Merrejk' Commander Merrejk; 'Mara Jade ETH' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Lord Vader' Lord Vader.
Posted 'Death Squd. Star Destroyer' dested Death Squadron Star Destroyer; 'Chimeria' Chimaera; 'Tryant' Tyrant; 'Zuckass in Ship' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Dengar in Ship' Dengar In Punishing One.

Posted 'Mara Saber', 'Vader Saber', 'Maul Saber' dested Mara Jade's Lightsaber, Darth Vader's Lightsaber and Maul's Lightsaber; 'CPI' Commence Primary Ignition; 'DS War Room'/'DS Conference Room' Death Star: War Room / Death Star: Conference Room; Alderaan, Yavin 4 and Hoth their Dark pages.
